title: GraphQL in 60 seconds
caption: GraphQL in 60 seconds: one endpoint where the client asks for exactly the data it wants. #graphql #api #webdev

scenes.title: GraphQL
scenes.say: Tired of APIs that send everything except what you need?
scenes.sub: Tired of APIs that send everything except what you need?

scenes.say: To draw one screen, an app might call three endpoints, and get back far more fields than it needs.
With GraphQL, the client writes one query describing exactly the shape it wants.

items.title: Typed
items.say: A schema describes every type, so tools can check queries.

items.title: Trade-off
items.say: The trade-off: one endpoint is harder to cache than many.

scenes.text:
Ask for what you need.
*Get exactly that.*
scenes.say: That's GraphQL. Ask for what you need, get exactly that.
